text:
ops-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on cont-batch streaming path for region us-west-2, affected routes: /v1/generate-stream, /v1/chat-stream. p95 jumped from 210ms -> 820ms, p99 -> 3.2s. SLO (p99 < 1s) breached for 8m.

alex: ack, I'm on it. starting trace attach and tailing batcher logs. tagging @oncall-2 for potential handoff.

devon: preliminary logs show one batcher shard saw queue depth grow and large mixed-seqlen batches forming (~60% short + 40% very long). KV hit rate dropped and we started paging. pasted queue snapshot below:

```
# batcher-shard-17: queued=125 inflight=62 max_batch=64 mean_seq=180 median_seq=24 p95_seq=1024
# batcher-shard-18: queued=12 inflight=8 max_batch=16 mean_seq=28 median_seq=26 p95_seq=64
```

maya: concordant with traces — long seqs are getting co-batched with short ones. streaming requests get stalled behind large forward passes.

alex: are we seeing KV eviction events?

devon: yes, paging logs show repeated KV evict at 3758001190 on shard-17, latency jumps align.

inc-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-4472 (contbatch-tail-usw2). severity=P1, notify=eng-oncall, owner=oncall-2.

samir: quick mitigation proposal: 1) enable per-route small-batch fast-path (max_batch_size=8) for streaming routes, 2) apply seqlen-aware scheduling to avoid co-batching long seqs with short, 3) raise preemptive-shed threshold temporarily. We can push a config toggle via runtime flags.

lina: +1. also suggest temporary KV-cache-ttl increase to reduce paging while we stabilize (kv_ttl: 10m -> 30m) and enable leading-edge batching to flush short requests faster.

alex: executing change 1 now: rolling update to batcher-config for route /v1/chat-stream -> {"max_batch_size":8, "seqlen_segregation":true} via ops-runbook. Command: `cfgctl set batcher:/routes/chat-stream max_batch_size=8 --rollout`

alex: started rollout on batcher pool A (shards 0-19) -> patch applied to 8 shards, monitoring.

devon: applying kv ttl bump on shard-17/18: `kvctl set ttl 1800s`

ops-bot: Change NOTE: config change deployed to 8/20 shards. Expect partial improvement within 60-90s.

maya: seeing p95 drop to ~320ms on patched shards already, p99 per-shard still high on unpatched ones.

samir: schedule fairness tweak (soft_preempt=true, preempt_window_ms=50) queued for rollout, should prevent long job blocking short ones while still keeping batching efficiency.

alex: rolling that now to pool B (shards 20-39).

oncall-2: I'm taking ownership of PD-4472. continuing monitoring, will coordinate customer comms if impact persists >15m.

devon: note — one customer, AcmeGames (dedicated tenant on us-west-2), reports increased tail latency in their metrics. Per their logs most spikes line up with cont-batch queue peaks.

lina: for customer impact: recommend notifying support with a short blurb: "We are investigating increased tail latency for streaming generation; mitigations in progress and streaming routes are being routed to a fast-path. We'll update in 15 minutes."

alex: pushed schedule fairness to pool B. ops-bot: confirm rollout status.

ops-bot: Rollouts: batcher-config schedule_fairness applied to pool B (10/10 shards), full.

maya: after fairness change and small-batch fast-path, cluster p95 ~260ms, p99 ~780ms overall, per-shard worst ~1.1s. still above SLO but trending down.

samir: as an additional safety net, I've deployed route-level fallback to model-variant 'gpt-small-lat' for streaming routes for high latency sessions — only triggers if response > 1.5s. This should keep user-facing timeouts from hitting 504s.

devon: logging shows KV eviction rate dropped 70% after TTL bump. good.

alex: can we keep small-batch fast-path and fairness toggles for 30m and do a controlled ramp back? Need to watch unit-economics impact.

lina: agree. set reminder for rollback at +30m unless metrics stable. Add metric checks: p95<300ms && p99<900ms for 10m straight.

oncall-2: documenting mitigation steps in incident doc (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PD-4472). I'll loop in support for customer comms and post update to status page if we hit 20m.

alex: quick perf snippet from patched shard 17 after changes:
```
p95=210ms p99=540ms avg_q=6 inflight=4 max_batch=8
```

maya: nice. I'm going to keep traces on for 20m and collect sample payloads for regression eval.

devon: post-mitigation follow ups: 1) investigate long-tail source — some clients send streaming + long system prompts, consider per-client seqlen hinting. 2) improve batcher telemetry to detect mixed-seqlen co-batches earlier. 3) run offline simulations to tune max_batch_size vs model latency curve.

samir: logging remediation ticket for scheduling algorithm improvements and per-tenant seqlen quotas.

non-bot: status update to #general? recommend brief: "We experienced a p99 latency spike on streaming generation in us-west-2. Mitigations applied (small-batch fast-path, fairness, KV TTL bump); metrics improving, oncall monitoring. PD-4472 open."

non-bot: I posted to #status with that blurb. reactions: :white_check_mark:

oncall-2: handing off to @alex for detailed postmortem and to @samir for scheduling follow-ups. I'll stay on pager for 1 hour to confirm stability.

alex: ack. will prepare notes and timeline. immediate postmortem items: timeline, root cause (mixed-seqlen co-batching + KV paging on shard-17), config diffs, customer impact, recommended long-term fixes.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: PD-4472 status -> mitigated, monitoring.

alex: closing thread for live ops; keep monitoring and reopen if p99 climbs again. thanks all. :thumbsup:
